methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free AI workshops targeting the technology gap in Hampton Roads signals grassroots capacity-building that could enable distributed, peer-to-peer AI fluency beyond the traditional NoVA hub—a direct counter to concentration dynamics.

signals.title: TAYLOR: AI data centers increase Virginia’s urban-rural divide - The Cavalier Daily
signals.signal_reading: Commentary explicitly naming AI data centers as drivers of urban-rural divide reveals infrastructure concentration in NoVA that extracts resources without distributing capability, reinforcing rather than bridging geographic disparities.

signals.title: AI pressure grows on Richmond's young workforce - Axios
signals.signal_reading: AI pressure on Richmond's young workforce indicates the capital region is experiencing capability demands typical of deep adoption zones, suggesting Richmond is emerging as a secondary hub alongside NoVA rather than part of distributed growth.

signals.title: How Roanoke College’s new pathways tackle the workforce mismatch - University Business
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's online workforce training pathways suggest platform-delivered, credential-focused AI adoption that creates broad access but risks shallow engagement—distribution without the depth of peer learning networks.

signals.title: U.Va. pilots three new artificial intelligence literacy courses - The Cavalier Daily
signals.signal_reading: UVA piloting AI literacy courses statewide signals intentional institutional effort to build foundational fluency across Virginia, potentially seeding distributed peer networks if knowledge transfers beyond Charlottesville to rural extension communities.
